# aukora-deep authority: issuer, broker, supervisor, guest

The AUKORA authority core from aukora-deep: the signing issuer daemon, the broker, the supervisor and launch topology, the WASM guest, and the courts, specs and launchd templates that exercise them.
Source: github.com/aumara-xyz/aukora-deep at c417f7c5752bf14b8e927986cd995f2e086f4189. The files were copied with `git archive` into `src/` at their upstream paths: all of `aukora/` and `courts/`, `ops/launchd`, `ops/launch-downward`, the issuer, broker, launchd and court-gate scripts with their specs, and `LICENSE` (AGPL-3.0), `LICENSE.MIT`, `LICENSING.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. The files the courts name outside those are also copied: `minimal/verify.py` (with `minimal/PROVENANCE.json` and its upstream licenses), `packages/governed/memory-put`, `profiles/8088-inside-out`, `apps/cli` (`package.json`, `src/`, `config/`), `docs/8088-READINESS.md`, `docs/specs/BRICK-0-CONTRACT.ts`, `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`, `archive/lab` and `vendor/loader` (with its LICENSE). `PROVENANCE.json` gives each file's git blob, sha256 and size.
Tests: from `src/`, run `node courts/harness/<court>/run.mjs` for each ordinary court arm listed in `scripts/court-gate-classification.mjs`, with the arm's own flags such as `--mutate`. Example: `node courts/harness/wysiwys-issuer/run.mjs --mutate`. Also run `python3 -m unittest discover -s aukora/verifier -p test_aura_consistency.py` and `node scripts/check-web-capsule-config.mjs`. `src/aukora/node_modules/@noble/{curves,hashes,ciphers,post-quantum}` are relative links into `vendor/aukora-kernel/deps`, which holds exactly `@noble/curves@2.2.0`, `@noble/hashes@2.2.0`, `@noble/ciphers@2.2.0` and `@noble/post-quantum@0.6.1`. Their tarball integrity equals aukora-deep's `pnpm-lock.yaml`. `PROVENANCE.json` `resolutionLinks` records each link.
Measured 2026-09-27 on darwin with node 22.23.0, with HOME and TMPDIR in scratch and PATH set to node plus `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`: 37 of 43 ordinary court arms matched the exact terminal line and exit status that `scripts/run-gate.mjs` expects. On darwin `uid-confinement` skips with exit 77, as the gate expects. `organism` holds 8/8 and detects its mutation. The python suite passed 15/15 and `check-web-capsule-config` passed.
These do not run here: `guest-import-purity` imports the `typescript` package by bare name. With TypeScript 6.0.3 resolvable, both of its arms match the gate. `live-dispatch` runs `pnpm vitest` in the installed DeepSeek Harness workspace. `amendment-channel` exits 77 (`tsx-absent`), and past that it needs the built workspace (`pnpm build:lib:host`). The enrolled courts need the built `apps/cli/lib`, `vendor/include/lib` and `packages/governed/memory-put/lib`. The `*.spec.ts` files need vitest.
